messages:
maria: Heads-up — starting a short sweep today for admin entitlement drift and KMS binding oddities. Goal: identify any lingering broad grants before next quarter's certs.

jamal: +1. scope? quick scan across prod projects, dedicated infra accounts, and stash of svcacct keys?

elena: Recommend we focus on: 1) roles with `roles/owner` or `roles/editor` granted to groups, 2) any service accounts with iam.binding to `kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` at org level, 3) long-unused temporary elevations.

maria: yea. I ran a sampling job with access-audit-bot, output looks noisy but flagged ~12 high-risk bindings. attaching a snippet:

access-audit-bot: Scan summary (last 30d): total bindings scanned: 4,120; high-risk matches: 12; probable stale keys: 7; svcacct w/ org-level KMS grants: 3. Link: https://internal/reports/access-sentinel/3380001234

jamal: can you paste an example of the noisy stuff? sometimes infra teams have delegated admin groups intentionally.

maria: example (redacted):
```
projects/rdw-prod/providers/iamPolicy
  - members: group:infra-admins@redwood.com
    role: roles/editor
```
Policy also shows a svcacct `svc-ingest@rdw-prod` with org-level KMS grant (looks suspicious).

govind: for the KMS bindings, if it's org-level `cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` for a svcacct used by cross-project backups, that's a real risk. We should confirm intended use before revoking.

elena: agreed. propose triage steps: 1) owner contact via SCIM group mapping, 2) check last use in audit logs (`timestamp`, `principalEmail`), 3) if no use in 90d, propose removal and open a change window.

jamal: ops-lead — can we get last-use info from logs for the three svcaccts? I can run a quicker log query if you give greenlight.

ops-lead: go ahead. please tag me when you have the list. I want a roll-back plan in case backups fail.

maria: running quick query now, will paste results. Also adding a small runbook snippet for removals:
```
1) Create PR to remove org-level KMS binding
2) Add canary policy to restrict to project-level key scoped binding
3) Apply in canary project, monitor writes for 24h
4) If no failures, roll out org-wide
```

access-audit-bot: Log query results: svc-ingest@rdw-prod last cryptoKey use: 2025-12-05 (backup job), svc-legacy-analytics last use: 2024-08-12 (decom), svc-deployer last use: 2026-01-02 (deploys).

sasha: looks like svc-ingest is still active. For svc-legacy-analytics we can probably remove the org grant but rotate keys if needed.

maria: action items: jamal to open PR for svc-legacy-analytics KMS binding removal + add canary; govind to follow up with backup owners for svc-ingest to scope to project key; elena to run group owner contacts for infra-admins mapping.

jamal: opening PR now — will link when created. PR will include monitoring playbook and rollback steps.

govind: I'll ping storage team and schedule a 30m check-in; if backups need org-level key temporarily we'll add a timeboxed exception and record it in exception tracker.

maria: good. also note we found a few admin roles granted to individuals who left last year — I'll coordinate entitlement handoff. recommend a short policy: auto-flag accounts with no activity in 180d for review.

elena: +1 on the 180d flag. can access-audit-bot add an automated weekly digest for flagged entitlements?

access-audit-bot: Scheduled weekly digest: enabled for channel #eng-security (summary will post each Monday).

maria: thanks all. we'll reconvene after PR and the log checks. if anyone discovers a critical blocker, please escalate in #incidents. :eyes:
